scope: Source-level review of twelve authored pair types before quality outputs from V10. No model-generated labels or real speech.
reviewed_categories: planned versus partial clause with a second actual report
single versus unresolved same-recipe historical anchor
report of missing versus query of missing
annotation_limitations: Hypothetical next is explain under the existing contract; intent boundary is a product convention.
Reported completion is a user claim, not sensor proof.
Expected facts are semantic assertions, not all progress statuses.
Synthetic constructions and repeated recipe instantiations do not replace natural held-out speech.
